Text: The string to lay out, one POP point per glyph. One line only.
Mode: scatter: glyphs fly apart on each beat. slit: glyphs are stretched into slits. noise: glyphs are warped by noise. extrude: glyphs are stacked into Layers copies along depth.
Speed: Motion speed multiplier. 1 = normal; 0 freezes the animation.
Trigger: Pulse: fire a scatter burst now. It fades out according to Decay.
Autobeat: On: beats fire automatically at Beatspercycle per 8 s cycle (at Speed 1). Off: only Trigger and the modulation beat fire.
Beatspercycle: Number of automatic beats per 8 second cycle at Speed 1. Used when Autobeat is on.
Amount: Overall strength of the motion for the current Mode. 0 = glyphs at rest.
Decay: How quickly a scatter burst fades after a beat; higher values settle faster.
Stretch: Slit mode: how far glyphs are stretched into slits.
Layers: Extrude mode: number of stacked copies of each glyph. Other modes use one layer.
Depth: Extrude mode: total distance in world units spanned by the stacked layers.
Fontname: Font used for the glyph atlas and the out2 text mesh. Falls back to the TouchDesigner default if not installed.
Spacing: Distance between glyphs along X (1 = default fixed pitch).
Seed: Random seed for per-glyph motion; change it for a different scatter pattern.
Tint: Base colour of the glyphs, written to the Color point attribute.
Accent: Colour that some glyphs are blended towards.
Accentamt: Fraction of glyphs that receive the Accent colour (0-1).
